theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_atg_graph_tangent_finrank
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (v₀ : Euclid n), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → DifferentiableAt ℝ u v₀ → Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v₀ : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k))) = n
